review.method: Assistant read every polished transcript turn sequentially without keyword/speaker filtering, then authored sparse markers and context exclusions; deterministic validation of provenance and references.

coverage.parserBodyAccounting: all non-whitespace body content accounted for

review.limitation: Full reading is not an independent second annotator or a gold-standard recall measurement. Source transcription uncertainty retained.

summary: Dusk temple exploration → first camp → dawn scout → long southern riding loop and second camp → next-morning Kharsan reconnaissance → reunion at bridge. Two nights; parallel scouting is counted once.
issues: No civil date spoken. All May dates are conditional on YAML start; two nights are independently narrated.
Sunset countdowns, spell durations, and scouting subtotals overlap. No single exact elapsed-hours figure is warranted.
Morning wake, preparation, travel duration and arrival clock are approximate; no forced reconciliation or extra night.
Wellby’s retcon changes event order within one trip. Ledger keeps source order and records the insertion.
Bridge endpoint is confirmed; westward departure is next-session intent.
Place IDs and names are local transcript labels, with no vault identity reconciliation. Map gestures and corrected cardinal directions do not justify coordinates.
